description: This file contains implementations of hyperbolic functions (sinh, cosh, tanh) for rational numbers, using Taylor series expansions and rational arithmetic. It includes functions for validating input, computing hyperbolic sine, cosine, and tangent, and handling large inputs with exponential approximations.

methods.name: IsValidForHypFunc
methods.description: Checks if the input rational number is within a valid range for hyperbolic functions based on the precision.

methods.name: _sinhrat
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine of a rational number using Taylor series expansion.

methods.name: sinhrat
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine of a rational number, handling large inputs with exponential approximation.

methods.name: _coshrat
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a rational number using Taylor series expansion.

methods.name: coshrat
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a rational number, handling large inputs with exponential approximation.

methods.name: tanhrat
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic tangent of a rational number using sine and cosine hyperbolic functions.
